CENTRAL PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL

I, Sarath Ekenayeka, Minister of Chief and Local Government of Central Province, here with enact the rules concerningmembers of Pradeshiya Sabha on the following allowances as per the powers bestowed to me by the 184th clause of thePradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987 which is to be read along with the 2nd clause of the Provincial Council Act, No. 12 of1989. These rules are to be implemented from 16.01.2013 (for fuel allowance) and from 25.01.2012 (for telephone allowance).
Rules
01. These rules are known as rules for paying allowances for members of Pradeshiya Sabha.
02. This is in addition to the allowances declared by the Extraordinary Gazette No. 1391/25 of the Democratic
Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka dated 06.05.2005.
Fuel Allowance
Payment of a monthly fuel allowance of Rs. 2,500/- for the members of Pradeshiya Sabha under Central ProvincialCouncil.
* This allowance is valid only for the members of Pradeshiya Sabha.
* If the Chairman/Deputy Chairman of Pradeshiya Sabha is not entitled to a fuel allowance so far, they can claim
this allowance. One person cannot claim two allowances concerning one matter.
* This is not relevant for the Urban Councils/Municipal Councils.
* Maximum amount paid for a member is Rs. 2,500/-. If one doesn’t own a bike/three wheeler or motor vehicle may
use any other vehicle and the relevant bills and documents should be produced ; running charts should beacquired.
Details regarding running for monitoring of development work of Pradeshiya Sabha should be produced.

Telephone Allowance
Payment of an allowance of Rs. 1,000/- for the members of Pradeshiya Sabha.
* Payment of an allowance of Rs. 1,000/- as telephone allowance for the members of Pradeshiya Sabha appointed
to the local government institutions under Central Provincial Council, on the basis that provisions are allocatedby the relevant local government institution.
SARATH EKENAYEKA,Chief and Local Government Minister,
Central Province.
16th January, 2015,at the Chief Minister’s Office.
